W:1. Save me, O God, because the floods Come in upon my soul;
W:I sink in depths where none can stand, Deep waters o'er me roll.
W:
W:2. My constant calling wearies me, My throat is parched and dried;
W:My eyes grow dim while for my God Still waiting I abide.
W:
W:3. The foes who hate me unprovoked Are strong and still increase,
W:Tho' to disarm their enmity My right I yield for peace.
W:
W:4. O God, my folly and my sin Thy holy eye can see;
W:Yet save from shame, Lord God of Hosts, Thy saints that wait on Thee.
W:
W:5. Forbid, O God, our covenant God, That those who seek Thy face
W:Should see Thy servant put to shame And share in my disgrace.
W:
W:6. It is for Thee I am reproached,
W:For Thee I suffer shame,
W:Until my brethren know me not,
W:And hated is my name.
W:
W:7. It is my zeal for Thy abode
W:That has consumed my life;
W:Reproached by those reproaching Thee,
W:I suffer in the strife.
W:
W:8. I wept, with fasting bowed my soul,
W:Yet that was made my shame;
W:When I in sackcloth clothed myself,
W:Their byword I became.
W:
W:9. The men who sit within the gate
W:With slander do me wrong,
W:And they who linger at their cups
W:Make me their jest and song.

W:1. Though troubles great o'ershadow me,
W:Thou art my refuge strong;
W:My mouth shall praise Thee all the day,
W:Thy honor be my song.
W:
W:2. Cast me not off when hoary age
W:Becomes my weary lot,
W:And in the days of failing strength
W:Do Thou forsake me not.
W:
W:3. My foes are strong and confident,
W:For I to them appear
W:As one forsaken by his God,
W:With none to help me near.
W:
W:4. My God, be Thou not far from me,
W:Make haste to hear my call;
W:Ashamed, consumed be all my foes,
W:Dishonored let them fall.
W:
W:5. But I will ever hope in Thee,
W:My ceaseless praise is Thine;
W:I will declare Thy countless deeds
W:Of truth and grace divine.
W:
W:6. Yea, I will tell the mighty acts
W:Performed by God the Lord;
W:Thy righteousness, and Thine alone,
W:With praise I will record.
W:
W:7. For from my early youth, O God,
W:By Thee have I been taught,
W:And faithfully have I declared
W:The wonders Thou hast wrought.
W:[Stanzas 5–11]

W:All white for harvesting,
W:And boundless joy and gladness fill
W:The city of the King.
